name: @pipeworx/mcp-data360

tools.name: data360_list_databases
tools.description: List the source databases aggregated by World Bank Data360 (e.g. WB_WDI = World Development Indicators, IMF_BOP = Balance of Payments, WB_EDSTATS = Education Statistics). Returns each DATABASE_ID with its full name and indicator count. Use a DATABASE_ID here to scope data360_search_indicators and data360_get_data.

top.description: Max databases to return (default 200, the full list).

tools.name: data360_search_indicators
tools.description: Full-text search across all Data360 indicators (every WDI/IMF/WHO/ILO/education series in one index). Returns indicator codes (use as INDICATOR in data360_get_data), names, owning DATABASE_ID/name, units, and definitions. Optionally restrict to one database with database_id.

query.description: Keyword(s), e.g. "GDP per capita" or "maternal mortality". Use "*" for all.

database_id.description: Optional: restrict to one source database, e.g. "WB_WDI" or "IMF_BOP" (from data360_list_databases).

tools.name: data360_get_data
tools.description: Fetch observations for one Data360 series. DATABASE_ID selects the source database (e.g. WB_WDI), INDICATOR is the code from data360_search_indicators (e.g. WB_WDI_SP_POP_TOTL), REF_AREA is an ISO3 country code (e.g. BRA, USA). Returns SDMX-style records with OBS_VALUE, TIME_PERIOD, UNIT_MEASURE and disaggregation attributes (SEX, AGE, etc.). Omit TIME_PERIOD for the full series.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-data360 forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the data360 pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
